reviews.comment: The supercomputing AI lab and Olympic 50m swimming pool are truly world-class. Everything on campus is well organized.
The robotics and IoT lab is equipped with actual industrial robotic arms and 3D printers that students can use freely for projects.
Huge 300-acre green campus. The soil testing and biotechnology research facilities are the best in South India.

reviews.college: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences
reviews.comment: Labs and indoor stadium are fantastic, but hostel Wi-Fi during peak evening hours could use higher bandwidth.
PSG Siemens Center of Excellence gives real industrial automation experience that helped me crack direct core placement.
The Robotics & IoT Labs are equipped with industry-grade Siemens PLCs and ABB robotic arms. 24/7 high-speed fiber internet in all research cubicles.
Unrivaled precision manufacturing labs and autonomous vehicle testing tracks. Campus canteen maintains stringent FSSAI hygiene standards.
Outdoor athletic grounds and synthetic tennis courts are exceptional. Suggesting longer evening access hours for the central digital library during exams.
Lush green campus area with high bio-waste recycling standards, Olympic-size swimming pool, and ergonomic multimedia lecture halls.
